CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to content is present (A absent).

COD.rationale: Content (red coordinates) is identified and its presentation/organization is stated; an origin record entry separately attributes status/metadata, allowing explicit C, O and D binding for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition linked to content presentation is present.

C.rationale: The report names specific contents (color labels) and gives attributes (coordinate tuples) explicitly.

D.rationale: Metadata/origin entries are presented separately from content coordinate entries, distinguishing identified content from its presentation/status.

O.rationale: The text states how content is organized/presented (grid directions and origin metadata), bound to current entries.
